title: Futures (revision) - Mastery of all future forms and subtle differences

question.en: Which sentence correctly expresses a future arrangement?
question.ru: Какое предложение правильно выражает будущую договоренность?
question.uz: Qaysi gap kelajakdagi kelishuvni to'g'ri ifodalaydi?

options.answer: I will meet you at 8 PM tomorrow.
I'm meeting you at 8 PM tomorrow.
I meet you at 8 PM tomorrow.

explanation.en: Present continuous is used for future arrangements that have been planned and organized in advance.
explanation.ru: Present continuous используется для будущих договоренностей, которые были запланированы и организованы заранее.
explanation.uz: Present continuous oldindan rejalashtirilgan va tashkil etilgan kelajakdagi kelishuvlar uchun ishlatiladi.

question.en: Choose the most appropriate future form for expressing a prediction based on present evidence.
question.ru: Выберите наиболее подходящую форму будущего времени для выражения предсказания на основе настоящих доказательств.
question.uz: Hozirgi dalillarga asoslangan bashorat uchun eng mos kelajak shaklini tanlang.

options.answer: It will rain tomorrow.
It's going to rain soon.
It rains tomorrow.

explanation.en: 'Going to' is used for predictions based on present evidence, while 'will' is for general predictions without specific evidence.
explanation.ru: 'Going to' используется для предсказаний на основе настоящих доказательств, а 'will' - для общих предсказаний без конкретных доказательств.
explanation.uz: 'Going to' hozirgi dalillarga asoslangan bashoratlar uchun ishlatiladi, 'will' esa aniq dalillarsiz umumiy bashoratlar uchun.

question.en: Which sentence correctly uses the future perfect continuous?
question.ru: Какое предложение правильно использует future perfect continuous?
question.uz: Qaysi gap future perfect continuous ni to'g'ri ishlatadi?

options.answer: By next year, I will have been working here for ten years.
By next year, I will be working here for ten years.
By next year, I will have worked here for ten years.

explanation.en: Future perfect continuous emphasizes the duration of an ongoing action up to a point in the future.
explanation.ru: Future perfect continuous подчеркивает продолжительность текущего действия до определенного момента в будущем.
explanation.uz: Future perfect continuous kelajakdagi ma'lum vaqtgacha davom etayotgan harakatning davomiyligini ta'kidlaydi.

question.en: Select the correct future form for expressing a spontaneous decision.
question.ru: Выберите правильную форму будущего времени для выражения спонтанного решения.
question.uz: Spontan qaror uchun to'g'ri kelajak shaklini tanlang.

options.answer: I'm going to help you with that.
I'll help you with that.
I'm helping you with that.

explanation.en: 'Will' is used for spontaneous decisions made at the moment of speaking, not planned in advance.
explanation.ru: 'Will' используется для спонтанных решений, принятых в момент говорения, а не запланированных заранее.
explanation.uz: 'Will' gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilingan, oldindan rejalashtirilmagan spontan qarorlar uchun ishlatiladi.

question.en: Which sentence correctly expresses a timetabled future event?
question.ru: Какое предложение правильно выражает будущее событие по расписанию?
question.uz: Qaysi gap jadvalga ko'ra bo'ladigan kelajak hodisasini to'g'ri ifodalaydi?

options.answer: The train will leave at 9:30.
The train is going to leave at 9:30.
The train leaves at 9:30.

explanation.en: Present simple is used for timetabled events and fixed schedules in the future.
explanation.ru: Present simple используется для событий по расписанию и фиксированных графиков в будущем.
explanation.uz: Present simple kelajakdagi jadval bo'yicha hodisalar va belgilangan jadvaller uchun ishlatiladi.

question.en: Choose the appropriate future form for the conditional clause.
question.ru: Выберите подходящую форму будущего времени для условного предложения.
question.uz: Shart ergash gap uchun mos kelajak shaklini tanlang.

options.answer: If you will come early, we'll start the meeting.
If you come early, we'll start the meeting.
If you are coming early, we'll start the meeting.

explanation.en: Present simple, not future forms, is used in conditional clauses introduced by 'if'.
explanation.ru: Present simple, а не формы будущего времени, используется в условных предложениях с 'if'.
explanation.uz: 'If' bilan boshlangan shart ergash gaplarda kelajak shakllari emas, present simple ishlatiladi.

question.en: Which sentence uses the future continuous correctly?
question.ru: Какое предложение правильно использует future continuous?
question.uz: Qaysi gap future continuous ni to'g'ri ishlatadi?

options.answer: This time tomorrow, I will flying to Paris.
This time tomorrow, I will be flying to Paris.
This time tomorrow, I will have flown to Paris.

explanation.en: Future continuous describes an action in progress at a specific time in the future.
explanation.ru: Future continuous описывает действие в процессе в определенный момент времени в будущем.
explanation.uz: Future continuous kelajakdagi ma'lum vaqtda davom etayotgan harakatni ifodalaydi.

question.en: Select the correct future perfect form.

options.answer: By 2030, scientists will discover a cure for cancer.
By 2030, scientists will have discovered a cure for cancer.
By 2030, scientists will be discovering a cure for cancer.

explanation.en: Future perfect expresses an action that will be completed by a specific time in the future.
explanation.ru: Future perfect выражает действие, которое будет завершено к определенному времени в будущем.
explanation.uz: Future perfect kelajakdagi ma'lum vaqtga qadar tugallanadigan harakatni ifodalaydi.

question.en: Which future form expresses a promise or guarantee?
question.ru: Какая форма будущего времени выражает обещание или гарантию?
question.uz: Qaysi kelajak shakli va'da yoki kafolatni ifodalaydi?

options.answer: I'm going to be there on time.
I will be there on time.
I'm being there on time.

explanation.en: 'Will' is commonly used to make promises, offers, and guarantees about future actions.
explanation.ru: 'Will' обычно используется для обещаний, предложений и гарантий относительно будущих действий.
explanation.uz: 'Will' odatda kelajakdagi harakatlar haqida va'da, taklif va kafolatlar uchun ishlatiladi.

question.en: Choose the most natural future form for expressing intention.
question.ru: Выберите наиболее естественную форму будущего времени для выражения намерения.
question.uz: Niyatni ifodalash uchun eng tabiiy kelajak shaklini tanlang.

options.answer: I will learn Spanish next year.
I'm going to learn Spanish next year.
I learn Spanish next year.

explanation.en: 'Going to' is the most natural way to express previously formed intentions and plans.
explanation.ru: 'Going to' - самый естественный способ выражения заранее сформированных намерений и планов.
explanation.uz: 'Going to' oldindan shakllangan niyat va rejalarni ifodalashning eng tabiiy usulidir.

explanation.uz: Future perfect kelajakdagi ma'lum vaqtdan oldin tugallanadigan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi.
